title: House Robber
oneLinerQuestion: Maximize total stolen amount along a row of houses without robbing two adjacent ones.
explanation: At house i, maximum profit is max(nums[i] + rob1, rob2), where rob1 is max profit 2 houses back and rob2 is max profit 1 house back.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION rob(nums):
    rob1 = 0, rob2 = 0
    FOR n IN nums DO:
        temp = MAX(n + rob1, rob2)
        rob1 = rob2
        rob2 = temp
    END FOR
    RETURN rob2
END FUNCTION
